thread:
maria: product wants org assertions deprioritized for a limited rollout to reduce billing noise. quick sync?
aj: lower precedence (project > org) or drop entirely?
sam: prefer lower precedence. full removal will break downstream mappings.
maria: plan: tenant flag `allow_org_assertion` default=false for canary. org used only as fallback.
lee: console needs to surface when org was present but ignored. otherwise support will get flooded.
aj: telemetry: emit `authz.routing.decision` with tags {selected, org_present}. avoid raw org ids; use `org_hash`.
sam: if request has org but no project, return `INVALID_ARGUMENT` + `authz.missing_project` event. no auto-create.
maria: rollout: 24h smoke on whitelisted tenants, rollback if `quota.denied.count` >1.5x baseline or `support.ticket.count:authz` spikes.
lee: sample log lines for SRE: `INFO authz: decision=project selected=service_account reason=project_assertion route=sha1` and `INFO authz: decision=org ignored=present reason=flag_off route=sha1`.
aj: i'll prepare rollback runbook + sample harness.
maria: action items noted. infra-bot: initiated canary (50%) for cohort.
